support_claim: Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, the MSA-HELION-2019 header names Helion Robotics Ltd as counterparty, and invoices bill Helion Robotics Limited.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet provides establishing evidence—not mere name similarity—that the billing referent Helion Robotics Limited and the counterparty named in contract MSA-HELION-2019 (Helion Robotics Ltd.) denote one legal counterparty; the packet does not preserve competing candidates or report that identity cannot be established.
